snippet.title: Trials Fusion Empire of the Sky DLC
snippet.description:
Empire of the Sky now available in Trials Fusion™! Play the all-new DLC in Trials Fusion™ by RedLynx and Ubisoft today and expand your adventure! 

Go even higher with this new content: 
- 9 new tracks 
- 18 new track Challenges 
- 5 new achievements/trophies 
- Dozens of new Track Editor objects including wrecked vehicles, warehouses and much more!

Buy it now on:
Uplay Shop : http://bit.ly/1mvI0qd 
PlayStation® Network: http://bit.ly/1rqqP0O 
Xbox Live: http://bit.ly/YJFSpt 
Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/311551  

Get the Season Pass to save over 30% on the 6 DLC Packs! More info on: http://trialsgame.com/seasonpass
